test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
'I × J' means 'I is the wife of J'

'I + J' means 'I is the husband of J'

'I ÷ J' means 'I is the sister of J'

'I - J' means 'I is the brother of J'

How is K related to M in the expression 'K - L ÷ M + N'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Husband
 Brother
 Wife
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: K - L ÷ M + N

It means: K is the brother of L, L is the sister of M and M is the husband of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ab547f18653d7be8b21b102677f45d50d64fffbed11037f426180ccf3cf9504.png] 

So, K is the 'Brother' of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Brother'.
